verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The finite flag-ideal/GAGA argument identifies the rational PL lattices on common algebraic models, while common refinements and equality of analytic and algebraic nef cones on the smooth projective central-fibre components identify their relatively-nef PL sub-cones. For the full cones, the MP-to-BJ inclusion correctly proves finiteness at the trivial valuation before applying BJ decreasing closure, and the converse uses BJ regularization by relatively ample rational PL functions together with the MP decreasing-net definition. The final DXZ comparison is an order isomorphism of the full psh cones and is not restricted to finite energy. Every cited numbered statement was checked against the primary source with matching definitions and hypotheses, and every downstream application is justified. No critical errors or gaps were found.
